models.label: Standard — Gemma 3 (1B)
models.description: Fast and lightweight. Runs well on most phones. Great everyday astronomy answers, fully offline.

models.label: Advanced — Gemma 3n (E2B)
models.description: Google's mobile-optimized model. Richer, more capable answers. Best on recent mid-to-high-end phones.

models.label: Top tier — Gemma 3n (E4B)
models.description: The most capable on-device model. Highest-quality answers. Needs a flagship phone with plenty of RAM.
